# Operations

- OPS-005: An app shuts down gracefully: on SIGTERM its host stops taking requests and gives in-flight work a shutdown timeout that ends before the platform's grace period (25 seconds where the platform allows 30, Kubernetes' default), and long-running work stops on the host's stopping token or the request's cancellation token, which every call passes on.
- OPS-010: In some hosting scenarios, use a pair of health checks to distinguish two app states: readiness (the app is running normally but isn't ready to receive requests) and liveness (the app has crashed and must be restarted). In the page's example, an app that must download a large configuration file before it's ready to process requests uses a liveness probe to describe the liveness of the process, with no other checks run, and a readiness probe to indicate a "not ready" state until the download succeeds and the app is ready to receive requests.
